Return the current notification counts for the authenticated user.

This is the JSON safety-poll fallback consumed by the frontend when the
EventSource connection is unavailable or not yet open.

Per-user SSE stream of notification counts.

Emits an initial event immediately, then polls every POLL_SECONDS and
emits only when the counts change. Sends a ``: heartbeat`` comment every
HEARTBEAT_SECONDS to keep the connection alive.

``max_events`` bounds the generator — after that many count-events it
returns. Pass ``?max_events=1`` in tests to get a finite response without
hanging on the infinite poll loop. Production clients never pass it.

Client-disconnect cancels the async generator (FastAPI / anyio propagates
the cancellation as GeneratorExit); the per-tick session is always closed
in a finally block.

Per-tick session: we do NOT use the injected ``db`` beyond reading its bind.
A ``StreamingResponse`` finishes only when the stream does, and FastAPI
tears request-scoped dependencies down *after* the response completes — so
an injected session on an endless stream stays checked out for the life of
the connection, pinning one pool connection per viewer. With the default
QueuePool (5 + 10 overflow) the 16th concurrent viewer exhausted the pool
and unrelated requests, login included, began failing with 500s. The
injected session is therefore closed immediately once its engine has been
captured, and every tick — including the first — opens its own session from
that same engine, so test-fixture engine overrides still apply.

AttendanceDayRowRead.title: AttendanceDayRowRead
AttendanceDayRowRead.description:
One person's scheduled shift on one operational date, with punch facts.

``first_punch_at`` / ``last_punch_at`` are the earliest and latest punches
inside this case's policy match window. They are timestamps of events, not a
check-in and a check-out: this provider reports no direction, so a single
punch yields ``punch_count == 1`` with both bounds equal, and a client must
present it as "seen at", never as a span.

``judgment_due_at`` is when the duty stops running and a lone punch may be
called unpaired: before that instant one punch is an arrival still waiting for
its departure, not an exception. ``absence_due_at`` is the earlier boundary,
twice the grace past the start, after which a case with no punch at all is an
absence. ``grace_minutes`` is the policy's own grace, published so a client
names the same arrival late as the evaluator does instead of guessing.

POST /leaves/{id}/amend — post-approval end-date change (Annual only).

LeaveCreate.title: LeaveCreate
LeaveCreate.description:
POST /leaves — manual record creation (v1: National Service only).

status / days are server-derived (lifecycle birth status; inclusive day
span); doc_path/certificate_path are never client-settable.

LeaveListItem.title: LeaveListItem
LeaveListItem.description: Slim projection for list views — omits notes and doc paths.

LeaveReturnRequest.title: LeaveReturnRequest
LeaveReturnRequest.description: POST /leaves/{id}/return — file the Duty Resumption (return) form.

LeaveUpdate.title: LeaveUpdate
LeaveUpdate.description:
PATCH payload. Dates are accepted only where the lifecycle allows date
edits (National Service while Pending — delay/extend).

LedgerAttachmentMeta.title: LedgerAttachmentMeta
LedgerAttachmentMeta.description:
Per-attachment metadata for the detail view.

Populated by ``GET /{id}`` from disk; the other endpoints that return
``LedgerEntryRead`` leave it empty (the drawer only reads the full entry).
``index`` is the position in ``attachment_paths`` (stable; used to address
the file by ``/attachments/by-index/{index}`` so Arabic/spaced filenames
never go in the URL path). ``size`` is the on-disk byte count, or 0 when the
file is missing.

LedgerEntryCreate.title: LedgerEntryCreate
LedgerEntryCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating a new ledger entry.

LedgerEntryRead.title: LedgerEntryRead
LedgerEntryRead.description: Full row — returned by GET /{id}, POST, and PATCH.

LedgerEntryUpdate.title: LedgerEntryUpdate
LedgerEntryUpdate.description: All fields optional — partial update (PATCH semantics).

LedgerListItem.title: LedgerListItem
LedgerListItem.description:
Slim projection for list / timeline views.

Omits ``notes_html`` (can be large). ``attachment_count`` is exposed
instead of ``attachment_paths`` so the timeline can show a paperclip
glyph without paying the full-paths-of-every-row cost.

LinkSelfRequest.title: LinkSelfRequest
LinkSelfRequest.description:
Set (or clear, admin-only) the signed-in user's own employee link.

``employee_id`` is the G-number to claim; ``null`` clears the link.

ManagerUpdate.title: ManagerUpdate
ManagerUpdate.description: Partial update. All fields optional. `sig_path` is NOT client-settable.

PermitRevoke.title: PermitRevoke
PermitRevoke.description: POST /permits/{id}/revoke — end a permit before its expiry.

PermitUpdate.title: PermitUpdate
PermitUpdate.description: PATCH /permits/{id} — edit header fields (not the lifecycle status).

PermitVehicleUpdate.title: PermitVehicleUpdate
PermitVehicleUpdate.description:
PATCH /permits/{id}/vehicles/{vid} — edit fields of an existing vehicle.

A partial patch: only the fields sent are changed (``exclude_unset`` in the
service). Used to back-fill the plate emirate on vehicles added before the
dropdown existed.

PermitVisitCreate.title: PermitVisitCreate
PermitVisitCreate.description: POST /permits/{id}/visits — gate/UAE-ID scanner hook (no v1 UI).

PersonIdScan.title: PersonIdScan
PersonIdScan.description: OCR pre-fill result for an Emirates ID.

RecipientListCreate.title: RecipientListCreate
RecipientListCreate.description: Payload to create a list. Owner comes from the session, never here.

RecipientListMember.title: RecipientListMember
RecipientListMember.description: One recipient in a list — pinned to the To or Cc field on apply.

RecipientListUpdate.title: RecipientListUpdate
RecipientListUpdate.description: Partial update — rename and/or replace the whole members array.

RegisterResult.title: RegisterResult
RegisterResult.description:
Outcome of ``POST /auth/register``.

``status='active'`` means the account was the first one and was
auto-promoted to admin (``user`` is populated + a session is set);
``status='pending'`` means it awaits admin approval.

RejectRequest.title: RejectRequest
RejectRequest.description: Decline a pending request. ``reason`` is recorded in the audit log.

ServiceFacetRead.title: ServiceFacetRead
ServiceFacetRead.description:
One Records-rail entry: a service id, its record count, and how those
records split across approval states (drives the rail's mini-dots).

SessionUser.title: SessionUser
SessionUser.description: The signed-in user, shaped for the frontend auth context.

SetPermissionRequest.title: SetPermissionRequest
SetPermissionRequest.description:
Set or clear a single per-user capability override.

``effect`` is ``grant`` / ``deny`` to set, or ``null`` to clear (revert to
the role default).  ``expires_at`` makes a grant time-limited; omit (or
pass ``null``) for a permanent grant.  Expiry is only meaningful for
``grant`` effects; it is stored for ``deny`` too but has no resolution
impact.

SmartFolderCreate.title: SmartFolderCreate
SmartFolderCreate.description: Payload to create a folder (confirmed). Owner comes from the session.

SmartFolderDismiss.title: SmartFolderDismiss
SmartFolderDismiss.description: Payload to dismiss a suggestion cluster (per-user).

SmartFolderRead.title: SmartFolderRead
SmartFolderRead.description: An active smart folder with its live matching-entry count.

SmartFolderSuggestion.title: SmartFolderSuggestion
SmartFolderSuggestion.description: A suggested subject cluster the caller could turn into a folder.

TimesheetCellUpdate.title: TimesheetCellUpdate
TimesheetCellUpdate.description: Force one cell. ``code: null`` clears it back to the derived value.

TimesheetDesignationOrder.title: TimesheetDesignationOrder
TimesheetDesignationOrder.description: The full designation catalog in its new order — every id, exactly once.

TimesheetDesignationRead.title: TimesheetDesignationRead
TimesheetDesignationRead.description: One printable designation from the catalog.

TimesheetDesignationUpdate.title: TimesheetDesignationUpdate
TimesheetDesignationUpdate.description: The two printable names changed by a catalog rename.

TimesheetFillerUpdate.title: TimesheetFillerUpdate
TimesheetFillerUpdate.description: The code statistics block 2 prints for one employee.

TimesheetGridResponse.title: TimesheetGridResponse
TimesheetGridResponse.description: One month of one workbook, live or sealed.

TimesheetIssue.title: TimesheetIssue
TimesheetIssue.description:
One preflight finding. Blocking stops a download; a warning never does.

Reported per employee, never nested inside a row: ``warnings`` is recomputed
live even on a closed month, so an ``employee_id`` here may name someone with
no row in the same response (a departure, or someone hired after the seal).

TimesheetPeriodPatch.title: TimesheetPeriodPatch
TimesheetPeriodPatch.description: The month's contracted post count and any block-2 filler choices.

TimesheetRemoved.title: TimesheetRemoved
TimesheetRemoved.description: Someone who finished last month and is therefore off this roster.

TimesheetRosterAssignmentWrite.title: TimesheetRosterAssignmentWrite
TimesheetRosterAssignmentWrite.description: One employee's designation from an effective month onward.

TimesheetRosterBatch.title: TimesheetRosterBatch
TimesheetRosterBatch.description: A non-empty atomic month roster update.

TimesheetRow.title: TimesheetRow
TimesheetRow.description: One printed row: the identity block, 31 cells, and both statistics.

TimesheetStartAckRequest.title: TimesheetStartAckRequest
TimesheetStartAckRequest.description: Accept a mid-month joiner's starting point. Changes no cell.

UserPermissionRead.title: UserPermissionRead
UserPermissionRead.description:
A user's effective capabilities + the per-capability override state.

``effective`` is the resolved set (role defaults ± overrides). ``overrides``
maps capability id → ``grant``/``deny`` for the rows the admin has set.
``role_defaults`` is the user's role preset, so the UI can show
inherited-vs-overridden.

VaultEntry.title: VaultEntry
VaultEntry.description:
Represents one file inside a vault folder.

Built directly from filesystem listings since v3 didn't index files in
SQLite — we follow the same pattern in Phase 03 (vault_files table fills
up only on POST upload, and the GET tree walks the disk).

VaultTree.title: VaultTree
VaultTree.description:
Tree returned by ``GET /employees/{id}/vault``.

Each key is a :class:`VaultKind` and the value is the file list. Order is
stable: ``uae_id``, ``passport``, ``other``, ``leaves``, ``violations``.

VehicleLicenceScan.title: VehicleLicenceScan
VehicleLicenceScan.description:
OCR pre-fill result for a vehicle licence (mulkiya). All optional; the
operator confirms/edits every field before saving.

WorkCrewPatch.title: WorkCrewPatch
WorkCrewPatch.description: Mutable crew attributes; a referenced crew code is enforced server-side immutable.

WorkforceConfiguration.title: WorkforceConfiguration
WorkforceConfiguration.description:
Validated configuration persisted exclusively under ``workforce.*`` keys.

This deliberately contains operational values only.  Provider URLs,
credentials, TLS configuration, and adapter-specific controls are supplied
by the environment and cannot be represented by this API/storage contract.

WorkforceConfigurationRead.title: WorkforceConfigurationRead
WorkforceConfigurationRead.description: Truthful configuration state without invented site-policy defaults.

WorkforceReadinessRead.title: WorkforceReadinessRead
WorkforceReadinessRead.description: Non-identifying setup gates for truthful dashboard state rendering.

WorkforceScopeWrite.title: WorkforceScopeWrite
WorkforceScopeWrite.description:
One normalized hierarchy grant; the router rejects duplicate grants.

``department`` is optional on a unit or post grant because this roster is
placed by duty unit and only part of it records a department.
